pod_brdg.guide.main.body:
§o§7Created by Podcrash§r

The Bridges Add-On has finally crossed over! BRIDGES adds a plethora of foot bridges to your world, craftable from all sorts of wood and stone materials. 

If you lose the book you can re-craft it with a book and a §estick§r. You can also access this guide with the command §7/podbridges§r at anytime.

For more information and support, check out §3§ohttps://pdcr.sh/bridges§r
pod_brdg.guide.main.title: Bridges Add-On
pod_brdg.guide.placement.body:
When placing a bridge it will have railing on all four sides unless placed next to another bridge or by the edge of a cliff. Bridges placed together will automatically connect.

You can toggle railing by interacting while sneaking with the bridge using an empty hand.

You can speed place bridges horizontally (similar to scaffolding) by interacting with a bridge while holding bridge blocks.

By sneaking and placing a bridge on the edge block of a gap you can start a bridge one block into the gap.

Supports can be stacked on top of each other by interacting with a support while holding support item of the same type.
